sceneConcept: A slender twenty-nine-year-old Chinese analyst stands alone against a transparent background. Straight short black hair, grey eyes, thin rectangular glasses and a quiet flat expression give him the air of a librarian returning a book. He wears an ash-grey cardigan over a pale grey collared shirt, charcoal trousers, a simple belt and black loafers. Both hands hold one plain closed slate-grey hard-backed work folio against his chest. Soft even frontal studio light preserves the single desaturated color family.
naturalLanguageDetail: A slender twenty-nine-year-old Chinese analyst with straight short black hair, grey eyes, thin rectangular glasses and a flat quiet expression wears an ash-grey cardigan, pale grey collared shirt, charcoal trousers and black loafers while holding one plain closed slate-grey hard-backed work folio against his chest with both hands under soft even frontal studio light; the portrait is framed from head to mid-thigh in a strict cowboy shot, with lower legs and feet outside the image.
